fieldValues.title: Sense: notice what matters and hear it
fieldValues.purpose: Nothing that matters goes unnoticed: the owner's experience is captured as it was said, and every session knows where things stand before it acts.
fieldValues.in_scope: The owner's words, the desk, session start, intake of requests and findings, signals from the repositories.
fieldValues.out_of_scope: Deciding what the words mean (Make meaning) and what to do about them (Choose a response).
